_help: Home page shelves and cards. Each toy card can have its own look: title (its fun name), topic (what it teaches, in plain words), font (luckiest, bungee, bangers or chewy), accent (blue, mint, coral, violet or yellow) and cover (a picture in assets/covers). If you rename a toy, also change its name in its own index.html and in quizzes/index.json. status: live (clickable) or soon (shows Coming soon). A card can set its own status to override its shelf. Each live card's id must match its toy file in data/toys/ and its quiz in quizzes/, except cards with kind game, like Spot the Scam, which are stand-alone games without a certificate.
